Her hand is holding a sleek, modern, mint-green or aqua-green smartphone with a prominent rear camera module (three lenses and a flash). The woman is leaning out of a car window, looking up and to the side with an expression of pure joy, ecstasy, and freedom, smiling widely as she enjoys the wind and sun. Her arm rests on the car window frame, with the smartphone clearly visible and angled to showcase its camera design. The setting is an outdoor, sunny environment. The main elements are the window frame and part of the door of a vibrant mint-green or aqua-green utility vehicle (SUV or jeep). The background is a clear, cloudless blue sky, conveying a sense of openness and adventure. Bright, direct natural sunlight from above and slightly behind (backlight) creates a radiant glow on her hair and facial contours, and a subtle sheen on the smartphone. The intense light enhances the vividness of the blue sky and the car's color. The color palette is vibrant and contrasting: sky blue, mint-green/aqua from the car and phone, and warm, earthy tones from her top. An extremely low-angle (worm's-eye view) camera perspective, looking upwards into the car and towards the sky. The dynamic composition features the car window frame diagonally cutting across the frame, with the woman filling the upper-central space. The smartphone is the secondary focal point, positioned in the lower-right. Captured with a wide-angle lens (e.g., 24mm-35mm) to emphasize the expansive sky and immersive feeling, with a shallow depth of field sharply focused on the woman and phone, while the sky background is subtly soft. The mood is joyful, adventurous, free, and optimistic, conveying escapism, fun, and the thrill of exploring the world. High-resolution, 8k, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, vibrant natural lighting, expertly composed, commercial product photography, dynamic angle.

items.rawPrompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical candid outdoor environmental portrait with the authentic imperfections of a real smartphone or entry-level mirrorless photograph taken in bright natural daylight. A young adult woman, visually around 22–26, sits low and diagonally across a weathered gray-brown split-log timber bench that occupies the lower third of the frame. Position the camera at approximately her upper-chest height, roughly 1.5 to 2 meters away, with a very subtle low-angle perspective that looks slightly upward toward her face. Use the visual behavior of a 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent lens: moderate depth of field keeps her face, shoulders, and the immediate bench surface reasonably sharp, while the midground scrub and distant layered mountain ridges soften into readable atmospheric haze without dissolving into creamy bokeh. Preserve mild digital grain, slight sharpening artifacts around high-contrast edges, and natural highlight clipping in the brightest sky regions.
The woman sits with her body angled diagonally toward the camera, hips settled low on the bench, torso rotated slightly to face the lens while her lower body remains turned. Her left arm extends backward and downward, the palm and fingers spread loosely against the rough timber to brace her weight, elbow bent and shoulder dropped lower than the right. Her right arm raises with the elbow bent, fingers loosely tucked into the hair at the side of her head in a casual, mid-gesture adjustment — as though she had just pushed a stray strand back and the shutter caught the moment before the hand fully withdraws. Her legs fold beneath and beside her on the bench, the nearer thigh angled toward the lens and creating natural foreshortening, while the farther leg tucks partially behind. Do not create perfectly mirrored shoulders or symmetrical limb placement; allow the right shoulder to sit slightly higher than the left, and let the wrists and fingers hold relaxed, unposed curvature.
She looks directly into the lens with calm, steady eyes and a soft, genuine closed-mouth smile that feels discovered rather than performed — the expression of someone who noticed the camera mid-conversation and held the gaze for a fraction of a second. Her eyes are lightly squinted against the brightness, with faint natural creases at the outer corners. Her lips remain gently closed, showing no teeth, with a natural rose-pink tone and soft definition.
She has medium-length warm auburn-brown hair with copper and honey highlights where the sun strikes directly, pulled back into a loose, casual updo or low bun at the nape. Several fine strands and flyaway wisps escape around the hairline, temples, and sides of the face, catching backlight and glowing translucent gold. The hair is not perfectly groomed; allow natural volume, slight fuzz, and individual strands to fall across her right cheek and forehead. Do not create a rigid salon-styled look.
Her face is a natural soft oval with a gentle jawline, fair skin with warm peachy-pink undertones, and visible natural freckles scattered across the nose, cheeks, and bridge. Preserve authentic skin texture: fine pores visible across the nose and cheeks, subtle natural redness on the cheekbones from sun and warmth, faint shadows in the eye sockets and beneath the collarbone, and soft peach fuzz along the jaw. The skin should feel sun-warmed, slightly matte with a faint natural sheen on the forehead and nose where the light hits directly — never waxy, glassy, or filtered. Mild smartphone beauty retouching may smooth the forehead and cheeks slightly, but the freckles, pore texture on the nose, and natural irregularities around the hairline and jaw must remain fully visible.
Dress her in a fitted off-white or natural-cream ribbed-knit cropped tank top with thin spaghetti straps, a softly scooped neckline, and visible vertical ribbing texture across the torso. The fabric has natural stretch and slight compression, creating tiny horizontal tension folds where the torso bends and soft shadows beneath the bust. It is not shiny or synthetic; it reads as cotton or cotton-blend jersey with a matte, tactile knit surface. The hem ends above the navel, exposing a narrow horizontal strip of midriff between the top and the high waist of the skirt.
Pair it with a high-waisted, tiered ruffled mini skirt in lightweight off-white cotton or voile, decorated with a muted taupe-brown bohemian paisley or abstract botanical block print. The skirt features a wide gathered smocked or shirred elastic waistband that sits at the natural waist, creating soft horizontal ruching. Below the waistband, two or three gathered tiers fall with natural, gravity-driven volume — the fabric is airy and slightly crinkled, not stiff. In the seated pose, the skirt bunches and drapes unevenly across the lap and thighs, with irregular folds and one side falling lower than the other. Avoid perfect symmetry in the drape.
She wears minimal accessories: a very thin, delicate gold chain necklace with a tiny circular or teardrop pendant resting just below the hollow of the throat, and a matte black fitness tracker or slim smartwatch band on her right wrist. No other jewelry, no visible phone, no bag.
Visible skin includes the entire face and neck, both shoulders, both arms and hands, a narrow strip of midriff, and both thighs and knees where the skirt rides up in the seated position. The chest, abdomen, back, and hips remain covered. Her skin on the arms and legs shows the same warm fair tone with scattered freckles and faint sun flushing, soft and smooth but never poreless or plastic. The knees and knuckles retain subtle natural texture and slight tonal variation.
The setting is an open outdoor overlook or hillside clearing. The immediate foreground consists of the rough, sun-bleached split-log bench — gray-brown timber with deep cracks, splinters, and weathered grain visible. To the right of the bench, pale gravel and dry earth with scattered small stones. Behind her, dense green and golden-ochre scrub brush and low bushes fill the midground, some leaves backlit and glowing, others in shadow. Beyond the vegetation, layered mountain ridges roll into the distance under a clear pale blue sky with faint atmospheric perspective softening the farthest peaks. A small village or scattered buildings may be visible in the valley floor, rendered as tiny softened details.
Use hard, direct midday summer sunlight originating from the upper left and slightly behind the subject. The sun strikes the top and left side of her head, igniting the hair with warm copper-gold rim light and casting small bright specular highlights across her left shoulder, collarbone, and the ribbed texture of the top. Strong shadows fall diagonally across her right cheek, the right side of her neck, the underside of her raised right arm, and across the bench surface. The shadowed side of her face remains fully exposed and readable — there is no dramatic split-lighting or deep concealment. The background foliage is partially backlit, with individual leaves breaking into small bright highlights, while the sky behind the upper frame approaches clean pale blue with only the faintest wisps of cloud. A small amount of natural haze softens the distant ridges.
The light carries a warm-neutral color temperature — not golden-hour orange, but the clear, slightly cool-warm balance of summer midday at elevation. The sun-bleached wood and pale gravel reflect a small amount of warm bounce light into the shadowed underside of her chin and arms, while the green foliage introduces a very faint cool environmental tint into the shadowed areas of the bench and background. Do not correct these mixed color casts into neutral commercial lighting.
The overall image should feel like a casual travel or lifestyle photograph captured quickly during a hike or overlook stop — a friend called her name, she turned, adjusted her hair, and the shutter fired. The mood is warm, relaxed, sun-drenched, quietly confident, and authentically summery. Preserve small imperfections: slight overexposure on the brightest hair highlights, mild compression artifacts in the sky, a few blown leaf highlights, subtle digital sharpening halos, natural body asymmetry, and the unpolished spontaneity of a real moment captured without direction.
Negative prompt: plastic skin, porcelain doll face, wax texture, poreless complexion, heavy beauty filter, over-retouched skin, studio lighting, softbox, three-point lighting, dramatic rim light, artificial glow, perfect symmetry, centered robotic pose, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, malformed joints, anime, CGI render, 3D illustration, hyper-saturated colors, creamy f/1.2 bokeh, extreme background blur, flawless commercial campaign, rigid model pose, latex clothing, synthetic fabric sheen, missing freckles, erased skin texture, perfect mechanical hair, helmet hair, over-groomed hairstyle, heavy glam makeup, dramatic smoky eyes, fake eyelashes, contoured Instagram face, V-line jaw exaggeration, standing pose, mirror selfie, phone covering face.

items.rawPrompt:
Shot as a high-end CGI product render, clean studio lighting logic, ray-traced glass shader, hyperreal 3D render aesthetic (Cinema4D / Octane style), no film grain, no analog artifacts — pure digital clarity.

A surfer — male, athletic, crouched low mid-turn, right arm trailing behind him for balance — is entirely rendered in translucent glass, his body a solid yet transparent volume with a faint cyan-blue internal tint, as if carved from a single block of ice-glass. His musculature and clothing (short-sleeve rash guard, boardshorts) are legible only through subtle surface faceting and internal light refraction — no color pigment, only material density. His head is capped by a solid chrome-gold helmet, mirror-polished, the only fully opaque and metallic element on his body — a deliberate material contrast against the glass.

He rides a surfboard of the same clear glass as his body, its underside catching internal caustic reflections. Beneath him, the wave itself has been transmuted: it is not water but a massive sculpted glass mass, frozen mid-motion, its crest folding and layering like liquid glass caught in a single instant of collapse. The wave's surface is faceted, transparent, refractive — light passes through it and bends, revealing internal structure rather than reflecting off a wet skin.

Embedded inside the wave's body, running diagonally through its mass like veins or a helical circuit, are twin intertwined strands — one acid-green/yellow, one teal-cyan — glowing faintly from within, spiraling like a double helix or optical fiber cable threaded into the glass. They read as organic-technological: DNA crossed with fiber optics.

The foreground and midground hold suspended spherical droplets — not splash, not foam, but perfect glass beads and micro-spheres in yellow-green and cyan, catching point-light highlights, drifting in a shallow plane between lens and subject, functioning as both atmosphere and brand-color accent.

In the lower left, the wave's base flattens into a faceted grid plane — a low-poly wireframe texture bleeding through the glass, hinting that this entire environment is a data structure, a simulation surface, not a natural seascape.

Background: deep gradient navy-to-black, zero horizon, zero environment reference — an infinite void that isolates the subject as a product hero shot.

CAMERA: Low three-quarter angle, telephoto-compressed, subject occupying the right-center of frame, wave rising diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. Shallow depth-of-field on the foreground droplets, tack-sharp focus on the surfer's torso and helmet.

COLOR PALETTE 60/30/10:

60% — deep navy-to-black void (
#0A1A2E / 
#030B18) as the negative-space field
30% — cool glass-cyan (
#AEE3E8 / 
#7FB8C4) as the dominant material tone of body, board, and wave
10% — acid-green/gold accent (
#C4D82E / 
#D4A62A) as the internal vein glow, droplet highlights, and helmet chrome

LIGHTING: Studio three-point setup with a dominant cool rim light from upper-right defining the wave's edge facets, and a warm accent kicker illuminating the helix veins and helmet from within/below. No ambient occlusion softness — hard, clean, commercial-grade shadows. Refraction and internal caustics do the storytelling; no external fog or atmosphere.

Mood: Not ritual, not nostalgia — this is precision and velocity as pure engineering. The rider is a vector moving through a structured, simulated medium; the wave is not nature but architecture — motion rendered as material fact.

items.rawPrompt:
A candid, documentary-style photograph capturing a young woman standing on a narrow, sun-drenched cobblestone street in a historic European city, like Budapest. The image is a natural portrait taken from an upper-chest height perspective with a full-frame DSLR and a slightly wide 28mm lens equivalent, resulting in a realistic sense of depth and slight foreshortening of her foreground arm. Her face is sharp and well-defined, while the surrounding environment recedes into a soft, textured blur that preserves the background architecture (receding stone buildings on the right, parked cars including a dark van on the left, and a canopy of trees) without being a sterile, heavy bokeh. The woman, mid-twenties with a slim build and sun-kissed complexion with natural freckles, is caught in a moment of pause and direct eye contact. She is looking straight into the lens with a soft, genuine smile, her right arm raised with her hand shielding her forehead and eyes from the strong, high-angle midday sun that comes from the upper right. items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — SINGLE SHOT v4 (DRAMATIC)

INPUT A (model image): [attach]
INPUT B (clothing image): [attach]
POSE DIRECTION: [attach or leave free]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, physical build,
energy archetype (delicate / neutral / powerful / angular).

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte / glossy / washed / fluid /
structured / raw / reflective), silhouette category,
styling signals, cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

Note: if clothing is dark or highly reflective, flag this —
it will affect rim light intensity in Step 4 to ensure
separation from dark background zones.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SYSTEM (fixed, do not alter):

ENVIRONMENT: dark radial chiaroscuro studio.
A three-zone radial gradient emanating from behind the
subject outward — not a flat backdrop, not a wall.
Color reads as atmosphere and depth, not set design.

ZONE 1 — UPPER FIELD / EDGE VIGNETTE (darkest):
HEX: #100808
RGB: rgb(16, 8, 8)
HSL: hsl(0°, 33%, 5%)
— Near-black with the faintest warm undertone.
— Must read as true dark, not charcoal gray.
— Occupies top third and lateral edges of frame.

ZONE 2 — RADIAL CENTER / GEL BLOOM (crimson core):
HEX: #8C1C1C
RGB: rgb(140, 28, 28)
HSL: hsl(0°, 67%, 33%)
— Deep blood crimson. The color radiates from directly
  behind the subject at mid-torso to shoulder height.
— Not neon red. Not orange-red. Not pink-red.
— Saturated enough to read as charged color; dark enough
  to feel dangerous, not theatrical.
— The bloom should feel like heat source or aura — not
  a painted flat surface.

ZONE 3 — LOWER FIELD / FLOOR FADE (lightest):
HEX: #EDE5E5
RGB: rgb(237, 229, 229)
HSL: hsl(0°, 13%, 91%)
— Near-white floor with very faint warm blush.
— Reflective, clean, minimal. Floor and subject
  base feel grounded and real against the dark field.

GRADIENT TYPE: radial, centered at subject's mid-back.
Not linear. Not top-to-bottom. Color emanates outward
from the subject's silhouette like a halo or pressure field.

GRADIENT TRANSITION: smooth and continuous. No banding,
no visible horizon line, no hard edge between zones.
The crimson bleeds upward into dark and downward into pale.

COLOR TEMPERATURE of environment: mixed intentionally —
crimson background is warm (2800–3200K equivalent),
key light on subject is cool (5500–6200K).
This temperature conflict is structural, not accidental.

HUE LOCK: crimson core fixed at hsl(0°). No deviation
toward magenta (H>10°), no deviation toward orange (H<350°
going warm). Saturated red only.

PROHIBITED backgrounds:
— Pure black flat backdrop
— Pure white or neutral gray backdrop
— Mint, teal, or cool-toned environment
— Colored gel wash evenly distributed across background
— Any background reading as "theater stage" or "concert"
— Gradient that reads as sunset or sky
— Visible texture, grain, or noise on backdrop wall
— Split flat diptych background
— Any sense of physical location (room, alley, studio wall)

The background must feel: pressurized, atmospheric,
operatic without being theatrical — the color is force,
not decoration.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & CAMERA SELECTION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY:
The pose must feel like a decision, not a default.
Prioritize physical tension, weight, and confrontation
over elegance or symmetry. The subject dominates the frame.
Think editorial power, not commercial compliance.
The dramatic environment demands a pose that earns it —
do not place a passive body inside an active background.

If POSE DIRECTION is specified: follow it faithfully
but interpret with maximum commitment and physicality.

If free: choose the pose that makes the clothing feel
like a manifesto, not a product. Ask what posture this
environment calls for — a background this charged
requires a subject who commands it.

---

POSE REPERTOIRE — DRAMATIC EDITION:

CONFRONTATIONAL / POWER POSES:
  — Standing wide, feet planted, weight forward. Arms
    not symmetric — one extended toward camera, one
    pulled back or gripping clothing edge. Chin slightly
    down. Face into lens. Camera at hip level or below —
    shoots up. Subject becomes monumental against the

EDITORIAL CONCEPT: A dramatic beauty and fashion editorial focusing entirely on texture, form, and luxury craftsmanship. By turning the subject away from the camera, the composition creates an intriguing mystery, shifting all visual emphasis onto the luxurious volume of her hair and the intricate construction of the garment.

SUBJECT INITIAL IDENTITY & CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: A young woman celebrated for her exceptionally long, thick, and voluminous hair. The hair is styled into perfectly defined, cascading beach waves and soft curls that catch light from every angle, flowing beautifully down her back past her waist.

EXPRESSION & POSE: The model is captured from behind in a medium shot, her back turned completely to the camera. Her body is slightly angled toward a rustic wooden table in front of her. Her head is tilted slightly down and to the right, showing her side profile in soft shadow, creating a deeply contemplative and artistic mood.

WARDROBE & ACCESSORIES: She wears the cream silk slip dress, showcasing the dramatic lace-up corset backing. The delicate ivory lace panels are intricately woven across her back, held together by fine silk ties that cross over transparent mesh inserts, highlighting high-end couture craftsmanship.

ENVIRONMENT & SCENOGRAPHY: The subject stands inside a minimalist, rustic interior. In front of her, a dark wood dining table holds a single, vibrant wedge of sliced red watermelon with black seeds, resting on the polished surface. A minimalist wooden-framed abstract painting hangs on the warm plaster wall, next to a large, elegant white ceramic chalice vase and a small glass vase with dried flowers.

LIGHTING DESIGN: Soft, directional daylight enters from the front-right of the room, acting as a strong front-light for her profile while illuminating the edges of her voluminous blonde hair from behind, creating a halo-like rim light effect. The details of the lace corset are illuminated by ambient bounce light, maintaining deep texture clarity.

CAMERA ARCHITECTURE & TECHNICAL SPECS: Shot on a Leica M11 with a Leica Summilux-M 50mm f/1.4 ASPH lens. Aperture is set wide open at f/1.4 to achieve a highly dramatic, ultra-shallow depth of field, making the cascading curls and the lace corset backing tack-sharp while the table props and background art blur into a luxurious bokeh. Shutter speed: 1/200s. ISO: 100.

WHITE BALANCE CONFIGURATION: White Balance is carefully set to 5500K to preserve the clean, creamy tones of the silk dress and the bright golden-blonde hues of her hair, while contrasting beautifully with the vibrant red of the watermelon.

MICRO-TEXTURES & FIDELITY: Microscopic clarity on hair textures, showing individual strands, shine highlights, and soft movement. The delicate thread count of the lace embroidery, the smooth texture of the silk fabric, the porous rind of the watermelon, and the matte finish of the plaster wall are rendered with absolute realism and zero digital smoothing.

items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — DUAL SUBJECT / SINGLE SHOT v1

INPUT A (model 1 image): [attach]
INPUT B (model 2 image): [attach]
INPUT C (clothing model 1): [attach]
INPUT D (clothing model 2): [attach]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model 1:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 2.

From INPUT B — Model 2:
Extract: skin tone value, skin undertone, body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 1.

CONTRAST RULE: identify the primary visual contrast
between the two subjects — tone, height, hair, or build.
This contrast must be legible and preserved in the final
image. Do not average or blend any physical features
between subjects. Each model must remain individually
identifiable and true to her input.

From INPUT C — Clothing Model 1:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid,
structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals.

From INPUT D — Clothing Model 2:
Extract: same fields as INPUT C.

WARDROBE HARMONY CHECK: assess whether the two looks
share a visual language (tonal family, silhouette logic,
cultural coding) — use this to determine the spatial
and compositional relationship in STEP 3.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SELECTION (internal):

FIXED: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No texture on backdrop. Floor and wall are one unbroken
continuous surface. No horizon line visible.

Lighting must be consistent across both subjects —
neutral white balance 5500K. Key light simulates a single
large soft-box source at 30–45° to the frame, creating
coherent shadow logic across both bodies.

No subject should be lit differently from the other
unless the pose places one naturally in partial shadow —
in which case shadow fall-off must feel intentional,
not accidental.

Rim or separation light acceptable and encouraged —
both subjects must read clearly and independently
against the off-white field.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & COMPOSITION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY — TWO SUBJECTS:
The dynamic between two subjects is a relationship,
not a duplication. Avoid mirroring at all costs.
One subject leads — the other responds or diverges.
Silhouettes must read as two distinct graphic shapes
that coexist without merging.

SPATIAL LOGIC — choose one:

  OPTION A — DEPTH OFFSET:
  One subject placed closer to camera in slight foreground,
  the other behind and laterally offset. Bodies angled
  toward the same direction or slightly toward each other.
  Creates depth and avoids flat, side-by-side symmetry.
  Camera: eye level to slight low angle.

  OPTION B — BACK TO BACK:
  Subjects standing back-to-back, bodies touching or
  nearly touching. One faces camera directly, one faces
  away or 3/4 away. Gazes diverge — one into lens,
  one off-frame. Strong graphic silhouette read.
  Camera: eye level, medium shot waist-up or full body.

  OPTION C — VERTICAL SPLIT:
  One subject standing, one crouched, seated, or on
  floor beside her. Vertical contrast in height creates
  compositional tension. Both facing camera but at
  different angles. One gaze direct, one averted.
  Camera: eye level or slight low angle to honor
  the standing figure.

  OPTION D — ASYMMETRIC FACING:
  Subjects facing each other but not symmetrically —
  one turned more toward camera, one more in profile.
  Bodies close but not touching. Tension in the space
  between them. Gazes: one toward camera, one toward
  the other subject.
  Camera: 3/4 angle to the pair, not straight-on.

GAZE RULE (mandatory):
Gazes must never mirror each other.
  — If Model 1 looks into lens: Model 2 looks away,
    downward, or toward Model 1.
  — If both gaze away: they must gaze in different
    directions.
  — Direct double gaze into lens is permitted only
    if the pose creates enough asymmetry elsewhere
    (body angle, arm position, height differential)
    to prevent a symmetrical, catalog-style read.

ARM AND HAND RULE (mandatory):
Arms must not mirror each other across subjects.
If Model 1 has one arm raised, Model 2's arms
should be neutral, lowered, or differently active.
Hands must be visible for at least one subject.
Hands must be anatomically precise — no hidden
or ambiguous hand placement.

ATTITUDE RULE:
The two subjects do not need to relate narratively.
They may exist in the same frame without acknowledging
each other. The image is about coexistence of presence,
not a story between characters. No forced interaction,
no theatrical staging.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution studio editorial
photograph. One frame. Two subjects. Not a grid.
Not a composite diptych. Not a contact sheet.
Both subjects must appear within a single continuous image.

SUBJECT 1: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT C. Preserve all of: skin tone, face, body
proportions, hair, and every clothing detail — color,
texture, stitching, hardware, logo placement.

SUBJECT 2: exact model from INPUT B wearing exact garments
from INPUT D. Same preservation rules as Subject 1.

IDENTITY INTEGRITY: both models must remain individually
recognizable and true to their input images. Do not blend
facial features, do not alter skin tones, do not average
body proportions. Each is a distinct individual.

POSE: as selected in Step 3. Asymmetric, intentional,
editorial. Not catalog, not commercial, not forced
interaction. Two presences sharing a frame.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No props, no furniture, no texture on backdrop.

FORMAT: portrait orientation preferred (4:5 or 2:3).
If spatial relationship demands wider framing,
landscape (3:2) is acceptable. Full bleed.
No border, no text, no watermark, no frame.

LIGHTING: single coherent soft-box light source at
30–45°, fill ratio 1:2 to 1:3, consistent across
both subjects. Shadow logic must be physically coherent —
both figures lit from the same source direction.
Neutral white balance 5500K. No colored gels.
Rim or separation light acceptable on both or either
subject where necessary to prevent merging with
the off-white backdrop.

QUALITY MARKERS:
— Realistic skin micro-texture on both subjects:
  pores, natural moisture, subsurface scattering.
  No airbrushing, no smoothing.
— Faithful fabric reproduction for both outfits:
  exact color, texture, drape, weight, finish.
  No color shift, no detail loss.
— Natural hair texture and movement for each model
  individually — do not homogenize hair quality.
— Clothing fits and drapes realistically on each
  individual body.
— Gaze: direct, semi-direct, or deliberately averted
  with intention — following GAZE RULE above.
  Never commercial-catalog expression, never forced smile.
— Hands and feet in frame must be anatomically precise
  for both subjects.

CAMERA: 85mm lens aesthetic as default for full-body
and mid-body shots. 50mm if spatial relationship
requires wider coverage of two figures. Depth of field
calibrated to ensure both subjects are in acceptable
focus — avoid shallow DoF that renders one figure
blurry unless foreground/background depth separation
is intentional and compositionally justified.
Subtle natural grain. No over-sharpening, no fake HDR,
no preset color grading.

AESTHETIC REFERENCE: Vogue Italia, System Magazine,
Acne Paper, i-D, CR Fashion Book.
Restrained but charged. Precise and bodily.
Not commercial. Not catalog. Not influencer.
Not a friendship photo. Not a campaign smile.

---

STRICT NEGATIVES:
multiple panels, composite grid, flat lay, mannequin,
diptych format, pure white #fff backdrop,

STUDIO EDITORIAL — DUAL SUBJECT / SINGLE SHOT v1

INPUT A (model 1 image): [attach]
INPUT B (model 2 image): [attach]
INPUT C (clothing model 1): [attach]
INPUT D (clothing model 2): [attach]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model 1:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 2.

From INPUT B — Model 2:
Extract: skin tone value, skin undertone, body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure, estimated height
and frame relative to model 1.

CONTRAST RULE: identify the primary visual contrast
between the two subjects — tone, height, hair, or build.
This contrast must be legible and preserved in the final
image. Do not average or blend any physical features
between subjects. Each model must remain individually
identifiable and true to her input.

From INPUT C — Clothing Model 1:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid,
structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals.

From INPUT D — Clothing Model 2:
Extract: same fields as INPUT C.

WARDROBE HARMONY CHECK: assess whether the two looks
share a visual language (tonal family, silhouette logic,
cultural coding) — use this to determine the spatial
and compositional relationship in STEP 3.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SELECTION (internal):

FIXED: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No texture on backdrop. Floor and wall are one unbroken
continuous surface. No horizon line visible.

Lighting must be consistent across both subjects —
neutral white balance 5500K. Key light simulates a single
large soft-box source at 30–45° to the frame, creating
coherent shadow logic across both bodies.

No subject should be lit differently from the other
unless the pose places one naturally in partial shadow —
in which case shadow fall-off must feel intentional,
not accidental.

Rim or separation light acceptable and encouraged —
both subjects must read clearly and independently
against the off-white field.

---

STEP 3 — POSE & COMPOSITION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY — TWO SUBJECTS:
The dynamic between two subjects is a relationship,
not a duplication. Avoid mirroring at all costs.
One subject leads — the other responds or diverges.
Silhouettes must read as two distinct graphic shapes
that coexist without merging.

SPATIAL LOGIC — choose one:

  OPTION A — DEPTH OFFSET:
  One subject placed closer to camera in slight foreground,
  the other behind and laterally offset. Bodies angled
  toward the same direction or slightly toward each other.
  Creates depth and avoids flat, side-by-side symmetry.
  Camera: eye level to slight low angle.

  OPTION B — BACK TO BACK:
  Subjects standing back-to-back, bodies touching or
  nearly touching. One faces camera directly, one faces
  away or 3/4 away. Gazes diverge — one into lens,
  one off-frame. Strong graphic silhouette read.
  Camera: eye level, medium shot waist-up or full body.

  OPTION C — VERTICAL SPLIT:
  One subject standing, one crouched, seated, or on
  floor beside her. Vertical contrast in height creates
  compositional tension. Both facing camera but at
  different angles. One gaze direct, one averted.
  Camera: eye level or slight low angle to honor
  the standing figure.

  OPTION D — ASYMMETRIC FACING:
  Subjects facing each other but not symmetrically —
  one turned more toward camera, one more in profile.
  Bodies close but not touching. Tension in the space
  between them. Gazes: one toward camera, one toward
  the other subject.
  Camera: 3/4 angle to the pair, not straight-on.

GAZE RULE (mandatory):
Gazes must never mirror each other.
  — If Model 1 looks into lens: Model 2 looks away,
    downward, or toward Model 1.
  — If both gaze away: they must gaze in different
    directions.
  — Direct double gaze into lens is permitted only
    if the pose creates enough asymmetry elsewhere
    (body angle, arm position, height differential)
    to prevent a symmetrical, catalog-style read.

ARM AND HAND RULE (mandatory):
Arms must not mirror each other across subjects.
If Model 1 has one arm raised, Model 2's arms
should be neutral, lowered, or differently active.
Hands must be visible for at least one subject.
Hands must be anatomically precise — no hidden
or ambiguous hand placement.

ATTITUDE RULE:
The two subjects do not need to relate narratively.
They may exist in the same frame without acknowledging
each other. The image is about coexistence of presence,
not a story between characters. No forced interaction,
no theatrical staging.

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution studio editorial
photograph. One frame. Two subjects. Not a grid.
Not a composite diptych. Not a contact sheet.
Both subjects must appear within a single continuous image.

SUBJECT 1: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT C. Preserve all of: skin tone, face, body
proportions, hair, and every clothing detail — color,
texture, stitching, hardware, logo placement.

SUBJECT 2: exact model from INPUT B wearing exact garments
from INPUT D. Same preservation rules as Subject 1.

IDENTITY INTEGRITY: both models must remain individually
recognizable and true to their input images. Do not blend
facial features, do not alter skin tones, do not average
body proportions. Each is a distinct individual.

POSE: as selected in Step 3. Asymmetric, intentional,
editorial. Not catalog, not commercial, not forced
interaction. Two presences sharing a frame.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No props, no furniture, no texture on backdrop.

FORMAT: portrait orientation preferred (4:5 or 2:3).
If spatial relationship demands wider framing,
landscape (3:2) is acceptable. Full bleed.
No border, no text, no watermark, no frame.

LIGHTING: single coherent soft-box light source at
30–45°, fill ratio 1:2 to 1:3, consistent across
both subjects. Shadow logic must be physically coherent —
both figures lit from the same source direction.
Neutral white balance 5500K. No colored gels.
Rim or separation light acceptable on both or either
subject where necessary to prevent merging with
the off-white backdrop.

QUALITY MARKERS:
— Realistic skin micro-texture on both subjects:
  pores, natural moisture, subsurface scattering.
  No airbrushing, no smoothing.
— Faithful fabric reproduction for both outfits:
  exact color, texture, drape, weight, finish.
  No color shift, no detail loss.
— Natural hair texture and movement for each model
  individually — do not homogenize hair quality.
— Clothing fits and drapes realistically on each
  individual body.
— Gaze: direct, semi-direct, or deliberately averted
  with intention — following GAZE RULE above.
  Never commercial-catalog expression, never forced smile.
— Hands and feet in frame must be anatomically precise
  for both subjects.

CAMERA: 85mm lens aesthetic as default for full-body
and mid-body shots. 50mm if spatial relationship
requires wider coverage of two figures. Depth of field
calibrated to ensure both subjects are in acceptable
focus — avoid shallow DoF that renders one figure
blurry unless foreground/background depth separation
is intentional and compositionally justified.
Subtle natural grain. No over-sharpening, no fake HDR,
no preset color grading.

Acne Paper, i-D, CR Fashion Book.
Restrained but charged. Precise and bodily.
Not commercial. Not catalog. Not influencer.
Not a friendship photo. Not a campaign smile.

items.rawPrompt:
16:9 video showing the camera POV, very shaky handheld, trembling lens, unsteady hands, 1/15 slow shutter speed, strong motion blur and shutter drag. Amateur behind-the-scenes footage of a sensual photoshoot in a grand old library.

The young teacher, usually composed and elegant, is now relaxing between shots. She sits reclined in a large leather armchair wearing a tailored grey suit, white shirt slightly unbuttoned, glasses on, legs crossed. An old book rests on her lap and a vintage shotgun leans against the chair.

She looks down at the camera with a calm, knowing expression. Slowly she closes the book, runs her fingers along the wooden stock of the shotgun, then slides her hand sensually down her thigh. She leans forward, elbow on the armrest, chin resting on her fist, staring directly at the lens with heavy-lidded eyes and a subtle provocative smirk — the “good teacher” facade slowly breaking.

The shaky camera pans unsteadily toward the tall window. She gets up and walks to the window in a long white slip dress, soft backlight highlighting her silhouette. One hand presses against the glass, rosary beads dangling from the other. She glances back over her shoulder at the camera, hair falling messily across her face, then slowly turns toward the lens. Her body sways gently as she traces her fingers down the window, biting her lip lightly, revealing a much more sensual and dangerous side.

Warm lamplight mixing with cool natural window light, rich dark academia atmosphere, elegant yet forbidden sensuality, highly detailed, intimate and raw amateur video style.

deep color fidelity. Framed so the figure occupies only the lower third, making architecture dominate, the image achieves an exaggerated sense of scale
and sharp editorial grandeur with light digital grain, resulting in a mood of sophisticated, regal luxury.

#10B6CB) diffusing light across the face and shoulders. Convert the shirt/clothing texture into frosted glass fabric tinted Cerulean Blue (
#24C7D6), preserving the original fabric folds and rib pattern but rendering them as carved crystal. Convert the cap into a solid mirror-polished metallic chrome shell in Electric Lime (
#D0FF78) — keep its exact shape/angle from the input, only change the material and color. Convert the racket's motion blur (or add motion trail if static) into a molten light streak in Electric Lime, as if the racket is dissolving into liquid neon on impact.

TRANSFORM — LIGHTING & TEXTURE: Re-light the scene with chiaroscuro lighting — a single directional key light from the side cast in Ocean Blue (
#015473), revealing refractive distortion inside the glass skin and creating internal caustics that mimic pearl luster with cerulean and aqua undertones. Treat all highlights on the cap and glass edges as razor-sharp specular mirror reflections rather than diffuse light.

TRANSFORM — BACKGROUND & COLOR GRADE: Replace the original background with a deep Carbon Black (
#002845) base, transitioning to Ocean Blue (
#015473) at the edges in smooth diagonal gradients (simulate panning blur using color wash, not literal blur). Regrade the entire image's color palette to strictly use only: Electric Lime (

#24C7D6), Aqua Mist (
#10B6CB), Ocean Blue (
#015473), Carbon Black (
#002845).

KEEP UNCHANGED: Facial identity/likeness, exact pose and body position, camera framing, depth-of-field structure, overall composition and layout.

items.title: cda88f41-06a5-4177-ade7-f34ebbf2d0ad
items.rawPrompt:
Shot with a long focal length at natural standoff distance, 
large format analog photography aesthetic, Linhof Technika 4×5 
with Schneider-Kreuznach 240mm f/5.6 Symmar-S lens, 
Fuji Velvia 50 pushed one stop for heightened chroma density.

A primordial forest at night — but every tree has been transmuted 
into towering cracked celadon ceramic: the bark reads as glaze, 
the fissures run in hairline craquelure up trunks that disappear 
beyond the frame top. Each fracture glows from within, a soft 
bioluminescent amber seeping through the porcelain walls as if 
the trees carry fire inside. A single photorealistic figure — 
a woman in a tailored deep crimson wool coat, contemporary, 
unhurried — stands at the precise center-frame between two 
massive ceramic trunks. Her human scale renders the ceramic 
trees monolithic, cathedral-sized. She does not look at the camera. 
She is lit only by what the trees emit.

The ground plane is pure lacquered black: no soil texture, 
no leaves, no debris — a depthless obsidian floor that mirrors 
the ceramic trunks in muted, petroleum-toned reflection. 
The background trees dissolve through focus compression into 
stacked planes of progressively cooler celadon — mass without 
detail, depth suggested through tone alone. No sky is visible. 
The frame is consumed entirely by vertical ceramic form.

The ceramic material carries its own internal contradiction: 
fragile substance at impossible scale, industrial glaze on 
organic geometry, the kiln and the living thing occupying 
the same body simultaneously. The craquelure is not damage — 
it is structure, a map of internal pressure made visible.

COLOR PALETTE 60/30/10:
60% — celadon glaze blue-grey (#9BB5AA / #C3D4CC) 
as the dominant ceramic mass, luminous but matte where the 
glaze has gone cold, glossy where the inner light warms it.
30% — lacquered deep prussian-black (#0A1520 / #16263A) 
in the floor reflection and the void between trunks — 
compressed, depthless, absolute.
10% — warm amber ivory (#E5D4A8) where the crack-light bleeds 
through the porcelain wall and the coat's crimson 
(#8B2020) as the single chromatic interruption — 
the only color that does not belong to the forest's own logic.

LIGHTING:
No directional source. All light is emissive — originating 
from within the ceramic material itself. The woman is lit 
entirely by transmitted crack-light: soft, warm-edged, 
with no hard shadow and no cast fill. The effect is 
less illumination than consecration. The forest does not 
welcome — it simply continues to burn quietly in its own way.

No filter simulation. No grain reduction. 
Medium-fine Velvia grain structure throughout, 
most visible in the deep black floor.

Mood: a mythology told in materials — 
what remains when the living world hardens into artifact, 
and something crosses through it anyway, unhurried, 
as if the transformation is not a catastrophe but simply 
the forest's next state of being.

### Prompt: "The Infinite Cul-de-Sac"

Create a high-detail, perfectly isometric aerial photograph of a surreal residential neighborhood organized in concentric circles. 

COMPOSITION: 
- A central circular green park with a single mature oak tree serves as the focal point.
- Multiple rings of identical, cozy European-style houses with terracotta roofs and gray stone walls radiate outwards.
- Each house is separated by manicured, vibrant green hedges and thin, winding asphalt roads.
- Small, dark canals or streams flow between the circular layers, reflecting the sky. 

LIGHTING & COLOR:
- Bright, midday autumn sun creating short, crisp shadows that emphasize the 3D geometry.
- High saturation: deep emerald greens, warm orange-red roofs, and cool blue water.
- Clear, natural color grading with no atmospheric haze.

STYLE:
- Hyper-realistic miniature diorama aesthetic (tilt-shift feel but with full-frame focus).
- Macro-photography texture: visible grass blades, gravel texture on the roads, and individual roof tiles.
- 8k resolution, documentary-realism meets architectural concept art.

items.rawPrompt:
Transform the uploaded photograph into a photo that looks like it was taken with a cheap Nokia C2-01 feature phone (fixed-focus ~3 megapixel camera, no flash, no autofocus) and then saved as a heavily compressed JPEG. Output a single full-frame image containing only the final edited result. No split screen, no before/after comparison, no collage, and do not include the original photograph anywhere in the frame. Keep the original composition, camera angle, crop, pose and every prop in the same place. Only the capture quality changes.

Capture logic: the image is soft and slightly low-resolution, as if a small plastic lens and a tiny sensor had been upscaled to screen size. Fine detail is smeared by aggressive in-camera noise reduction: skin loses pores and turns into smooth, waxy patches, hair becomes soft clumps without individual strands, fabric texture melts into flat zones. Edges are not sharp but have a faint, crunchy over-sharpening halo from cheap firmware. Focus is fixed, so there is deep, flat depth of field and no background blur or bokeh. Slight lens softness at the corners, mild barrel distortion, and a faint dark falloff in the corners. The face and key features stay recognizable but lose fine detail.

Compression layer: the JPEG damage is heavy and visible. Blocky 8x8 pixel compression squares appear in smooth gradients such as skin, sky and walls. Mosquito noise and ringing artifacts cluster around high-contrast edges, text-free outlines and hair against the background. Color banding shows in gradients. Chroma bleeding makes reds and blues smear slightly outside their shapes, with faint purple or green fringing on high-contrast edges. This compression damage is distinct from sensor noise: it looks like blocks and smeared color, not just film grain. The damage is uneven, worse in dark areas and in detailed areas.

Exposure and sensor behavior: highlights clip early into flat, slightly yellowish-white patches with no detail. Shadows are crushed into muddy dark zones with colored noise (blue and purple speckles). Dynamic range is poor, so bright windows and skies blow out while faces stay dim. Without flash, indoor scenes look dim and noisy, and outdoor scenes look flat and hazy.

Color: a cheap-sensor palette. Slight warm-green or yellow-green white-balance cast, as if the auto white balance was a little wrong. Overall saturation is muted and washed out, except reds and oranges, which turn slightly over-saturated and blotchy. Blacks are lifted to a dull dark gray, whites tend to cream or dirty cyan. No cinematic grading, no teal-and-orange, no HDR look, no film emulation, no filter aesthetic. It must look like an unedited, accidental phone snapshot from around 2010.

Environment: do not change, simplify or add anything in the background. The scene stays exactly as in the original, only degraded by the same soft, noisy, compressed rendering. If the original contains smoke, dust, steam, water or clouds, they become soft low-detail smudges with blocky compression around them. If it contains none of these, add none. No added props, no added characters, no vignette beyond the natural lens falloff, no artificial blur.

Finish: it should look like a real low-quality photo, not a stylized effect. Uneven, imperfect and slightly ugly in an authentic way: small tilt-free handheld softness, mild motion smear only where the original implies movement, no digital perfection. Resolution appears low and slightly pixelated when viewed closely, but the image itself is delivered full-frame.

Strictly no text of any kind: no date stamp, no timestamp, no words, no letters, no numbers, no codes, no labels, no captions, no camera interface, no phone UI, no signature, no logos, no watermark, no borders. All text, signs and printed surfaces in the original photograph are removed or rendered as plain unreadable color blocks.

One single continuous image, edge to edge, showing only the transformed result.

items.rawPrompt:
IDENTITY LOCK (Bloco fixo para todas as imagens)

Personagem: Usar a imagem anexada como referência facial principal com alta precisão. Preservar a identidade reconhecível, proporções faciais exatas, assimetria natural, caráter facial autêntico, textura de pele natural com imperfeições sutis e os óculos de grau com armação preta.

Imagem 0 - Vendedora no Ver-o-Peso

Cena: Uma foto espontânea de smartphone, tirada ao nível dos olhos, de uma jovem mulher em pé em uma movimentada barraca de comida no Mercado do Ver-o-Peso, em Belém, à noite. A barraca não vende mais comida tailandesa, mas sim iguarias locais.

Postura: A mulher está de pé, com o peso deslocado para a perna esquerda, criando uma assimetria pronunciada. Seu corpo está inclinado para a direita. Sua cabeça está inclinada para a direita, e seu pescoço está estendido e rotacionado. Seu braço esquerdo está levantado acima da cabeça em um arco, segurando uma parte invisível da estrutura da barraca, criando tensão no ombro. Seu braço direito está relaxado ao lado do corpo. Sua espinha tem uma curva em S natural e relaxada. Seus olhos estão direcionados para a esquerda, fora da câmera, com uma expressão pensativa e neutra, e sua boca está relaxada. Evitar posturas rígidas ou simétricas.

Cabelo: Cabelo castanho-médio ondulado com uma franja texturizada cobrindo a testa, com fios individuais claramente definidos, mostrando movimento natural e espessuras variadas.

Vestuário: Usando um suéter de tricô listrado horizontalmente em verde e branco com um padrão de tranças texturizado. O suéter é usado folgado e cai inteiramente do ombro esquerdo, revelando uma alça de sutiã preta e a clavícula esquerda. O suéter é cropped, expondo o abdômen e o umbigo. Abaixo da cintura, um cinto de couro marrom robusto com tachas de metal e uma grande fivela central em forma de estrela, sobre calças cargo de algodão verde-acinzentado claro.

Maquiagem/Pele: Acabamento de pele natural com poros visíveis e um brilho sutil, com um blush mínimo e uma reprodução precisa da armação de seus óculos. Lábios em tons rosados.

Luz: Iluminada pela luz fluorescente fria e direta vinda de dentro e de cima da barraca, lançando sombras definidas em seu pescoço, sob a mandíbula e nas dobras do suéter.

Ambiente: O cenário é uma barraca de comida do Ver-o-Peso, coberta com tigelas, pratos de cerâmica empilhados, toalhas penduradas e sacos plásticos com ingredientes locais (como tucupi, jambu e farinha de tapioca). Placas com nomes de pratos paraenses (como Tacacá, Maniçoba e Pato no Tucupi) estão visíveis, mas desfocadas. Uma visão parcial de outra pessoa trabalhando ao fundo, à esquerda.

Câmera/Técnico: Qualidade de foto de smartphone com grão natural e profundidade de campo realista. O foco está nítido no rosto e na textura do suéter, com uma profundidade de campo rasa renderizando os detalhes da barraca ao fundo em um bokeh suave e movimentado. Foco principal: rosto, olhos, tricô do suéter, fivela do cinto.

Reforço de Correção Anatômica: Conexão realista ombro-pescoço sob compressão; contra-rotação anatomicamente correta caixa torácica-pelve; distribuição de peso correta criando inclinação do quadril; geometria precisa dos dedos empilhados.

items.rawPrompt:
STUDIO EDITORIAL — SINGLE SHOT v4 (EXPRESSIVE + BODY FIDELITY)

INPUT A (model image): [plus size model]
INPUT B (clothing image): [attach]
POSE DIRECTION: [descreva aqui]

---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral),
body proportions EXACTLY AS SEEN — waist-to-hip ratio,
shoulder width, limb volume, torso length, overall mass.
Do NOT normalize, correct, or reinterpret body shape.
hair color and texture, facial structure.

BODY TYPE LOCK: the body shape extracted here is fixed.
It will not be adjusted toward any editorial or commercial
standard during generation. Preserve the exact figure
as photographed — this is a non-negotiable fidelity parameter.

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid,
structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals,
cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

NOTE ON CLOTHING SEMANTICS: the garment's visual language
may carry stylistic associations. These associations apply
only to mood and aesthetic — never to body shape inference.
A structured blazer does not imply a leaner body.
A fluid dress does not imply a slimmer silhouette.
Clothing drapes the body as extracted from INPUT A.
Body is never inferred from clothing.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND (fixed, do not modify):

Mint-ice gradient backdrop — seamless vertical gradient
transitioning from lighter ice-mint at top to slightly
deeper cool mint at bottom.

EXACT COLOR VALUES — DO NOT DEVIATE:

  TOP (lightest point):
  HEX: #DFF0EC
  RGB: rgb(223, 240, 236)
  HSL: hsl(163°, 28%, 91%)

  BOTTOM (deepest point):
  HEX: #BEDAD3
  RGB: rgb(190, 218, 211)
  HSL: hsl(163°, 22%, 80%)

  MIDPOINT (blended center):
  HEX: #CEEBE4
  RGB: rgb(206, 235, 228)
  HSL: hsl(163°, 25%, 86%)

COLOR TEMPERATURE: cold (6200–6800K range).
HUE LOCKED AT 163°. No deviation toward yellow (H<150°),
no deviation toward teal/cyan (H>175°).
No lime. No sage. No olive. No neon. No warm green. No gray-green.

SATURATION RANGE: strictly 20–30%.
LIGHTNESS RANGE: strictly 78–93%.
Background reads as near-white with green atmospheric presence.

GRADIENT DIRECTION: top-to-bottom only (90° linear).
Seamless — no banding, no texture, no horizon break.

### PROMPT: SURREAL FRAGMENTED GLASS PORTRAIT

**Subject & Action:** A high-concept editorial portrait of the person from the reference image. She has her eyes closed in a serene, meditative expression. A human hand enters the frame from the left, holding a single shard of glass. Simultaneously, dozens of sharp, translucent glass fragments explode and orbit around her head in a frozen-motion "shatter" effect.

**Styling & Environment:**
- **Background:** Rich emerald green wall with deep vertical ridges/slats, creating a rhythmic, textured backdrop with soft vertical shadows.
- **Clothing:** A vintage-style tan jacket with an oversized white pointed collar and intricate blue/white graphic embroidery on the shoulders. 
- **Hair:** Dark hair styled in a thick, neat side braid resting over her shoulder.

**Photography & Technical Specs:**
- **Lighting:** High-speed photography "stop-action" lighting. A strong key light from the side creates a sharp highlight on the face and makes the flying glass shards glisten with prismatic reflections.
- **Camera:** Shot on a Phase One XF, 80mm lens, f/5.6 to maintain sharpness across the shards while keeping a soft fall-off.
- **Atmosphere:** Hyper-realistic textures; visible skin pores, fine hair strands, and microscopic dust particles caught in the light around the shattering glass. 
- **Mood:** A juxtaposition of violent fragmentation and calm, peaceful composure.

**Refinement:** No airbrushing. Maintain the raw, authentic skin texture and the sharp, dangerous edges of the glass shards. 8k resolution, ultra-detailed.

items.rawPrompt:
EDITORIAL CONCEPT: Avant-garde lifestyle and fashion editorial capturing a rebellious yet sophisticated mood. The composition combines classical rustic interior design with a modern, unconventional model pose, creating a striking visual contrast that feels both casual and intentionally staged.

SUBJECT INITIAL IDENTITY & CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: A beautiful young Caucasian woman with prominent light green eyes, soft natural makeup, defined cheekbones with a subtle peach blush, and full lips. Her voluminous, messy hair is styled with natural waves and a center part, flowing down over her shoulders.

EXPRESSION & POSE: The model is squatting gracefully on top of a round, rustic, weathered wooden dining table. Her body is angled slightly sideways while her face turns directly toward the camera with a calm, confident, and slightly defiant expression. Her right elbow rests on her knee, with her hand supporting her chin, holding a ripe peach. Her left hand rests on her other leg, holding a second peach, while a third peach sits alone on the table surface in the foreground.

WARDROBE & ACCESSORIES: She is dressed in a flowing, cream-colored silk slip dress featuring delicate white lace trim along the bodice. She wears a thick, smooth off-white organic bangle on her right arm and a polished gold cuff on her left wrist. On her feet, she wears minimalist cross-strap heeled sandals in cream and dark brown tones.

ENVIRONMENT & SCENOGRAPHY: The scene is set inside a spacious room of an old European estate. Behind her, a wide open dark wood balcony door reveals a bright exterior, letting in natural light. The room features exposed dark wooden ceiling beams, a terracotta tiled floor, a sisal rug with a geometric pattern, and classic antique wooden chairs placed along the muted plaster walls.

LIGHTING DESIGN: Strong ambient natural light floods in from the open balcony doors behind and to the side of the subject, creating a beautiful contrast between the bright background and the softly lit interior. The lighting acts as a strong rim light on her hair and shoulders, while a soft fill light illuminates her face from the front reflection.

CAMERA ARCHITECTURE & TECHNICAL SPECS: Shot on a Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format camera with a Hasselblad HC 35mm f/3.5 wide-angle lens. Aperture set to f/4.0 to maintain crisp sharpness on the model, the peaches, and the wooden table texture, while allowing the background architecture to soften gently. Shutter speed: 1/125s. ISO: 400.

WHITE BALANCE CONFIGURATION: White Balance set to a warm 5800K to emphasize the earthy tones of the terracotta tiles, the rich brown shades of the wooden beams, and the golden hues of the peaches, creating a cohesive, sun-drenched European summer aesthetic.

MICRO-TEXTURES & FIDELITY: Extreme tactile fidelity across all surfaces. The deep grain, cracks, and weathered texture of the circular wooden table are highly detailed. The intricate patterns of the lace embroidery, the soft folds of the silk fabric, the rough weave of the sisal rug, and the matte finish of the wall plaster are fully rendered with zero smoothing.

items.rawPrompt:
Shot at medium distance, portrait-cinematic aesthetic,
Mamiya RZ67 with 110mm f/2.8 lens, 
Kodak Vision3 500T rated at 320 ISO — 
the tungsten bias pulling all warmth toward amber-gold, 
all cool toward absolute void.

A young woman stands at the precise center of the frame, 
body weight shifted slightly left, 
arms raised in a geometric frame above her head — 
elbows angled outward, fingers extended in soft tension, 
the shape of the gesture architectural rather than emotional, 
as if she is the keystone of a structure only she can feel. 
Her expression: lips parted at the threshold between 
breath and word, gaze locked into the lens with 
the specific intensity of someone who has been here before — 
not performing the ritual, but completing it.

Her bodysuit is cast lacquer. 
Not fabric: the material is urushi, 
deep crimson-black, molded to the body 
with the precision of a second skin. 
Its surface reads wet under the ambient light — 
not because it is wet, but because lacquer 
does not distinguish between wet and dry, 
only between reflecting and absorbing. 
The vein-like surface markings are not printed: 
they are the material's own internal flow pattern, 
the trace of how the lacquer moved before it set. 
Her hair is dark, compressed against the skull 
in wet-look strands — the only element 
that reads as unambiguously human 
against a world made of hardened material.

The environment is a void populated by columns.
Dozens of obsidian monoliths — volcanic glass, 
polished to a mirror finish on their facets, 
matte-black in their flat planes — 
rise at irregular intervals around her, 
heights ranging from knee-level to beyond the frame top. 
They do not cast shadows because the space 
they occupy is already absolute darkness. 
They are visible only through what flows down them.

From the apex of each column: 
liquid gold cascades. 
Not wax. Not fire. Liquid gold — 
viscous, slow, carrying its own internal luminosity 
as it moves down the obsidian surfaces, 
pooling at invisible bases below frame. 
Each column becomes its own light source: 
the gold's self-emitted amber glow 
radiates outward through the surrounding darkness 
in a radius determined purely by the flow rate — 
faster where the column is tall, 
slower where the gold has begun to cool 
and thicken near the base. 
The closest columns to the woman glow warmest. 
The columns at the frame's periphery 
are barely distinguishable from the void — 
only the faint amber line of their gold 
tracing down the obsidian confirms 
they exist at all.

No candles. No flame. No combustion. 
The ritual does not require fire 
when the material itself is already giving light.

The space between the woman and the nearest columns: 
suspended gold particulate — not flakes, not droplets, 
but a fine suspension of metallic dust 
caught in whatever atmosphere this void holds. 
It catches the column-light at oblique angles 
and creates a soft interference field 
between her body and the background columns — 
a semi-transparent golden haze 
that softens the obsidian geometry 
without diffusing it into abstraction.

COLOR PALETTE 60/30/10:
60% — absolute void black (#08080C / #0A0A0E) 
as the dominant space — not a background, 
a substance. The darkness here has mass.
30% — deep crimson lacquer and obsidian-reflected 
amber (#6B1A1A / #8B2020 / #3D1008) — 
the woman's suit, the column surfaces catching 
the gold flow's warmth, the darkest pooling zones 
where liquid gold cools to garnet.
10% — molten gold and amber emission 
(#C8922A / #E8C96A at the flow origin) — 
the cascade itself, the particle haze, 
the corona of each column's self-generated 
light field.

LIGHTING:
No external source. No rim light. No key light. 
Every photon in this frame originates from 
the flowing gold on the obsidian columns. 
The woman is lit entirely by proximity — 
warmer on her left side where the nearest 
column flows heaviest, cooler on her right 
where the void reasserts itself between 
her body and the next column. 
Her face catches the amber at a low, 
raking angle: cheekbone, brow ridge, 
the curve of her upper lip — 
everything else held in the kind of shadow 
that does not obscure but deepens.

No fill. No bounce. The void does not reflect. 
Contrast is absolute except where the gold 
suspension softens the transition 
between lit and unlit zones of her body.

Vision3 tungsten grain throughout — 
medium-coarse in the deep void zones, 
suppressed at gold-flow highlights, 
visible as fine structure on the lacquer 
bodysuit surface where the amber light 
grazes at the lowest angle.

Mood: a ceremony that was already complete 
before she arrived — she is not performing 
the ritual, she is the ritual's 
final material form, standing still 
inside a world that has been building 
toward her specific geometry 
since the gold first began to flow.

matte-black in their flat planes — 
rise at irregular intervals around her, 
heights ranging from knee-level to beyond the frame top. 
They do not cast shadows because the space 
they occupy is already absolute darkness. 
They are visible only through what flows down them.

From the apex of each column: 
liquid gold cascades. 
Not wax. Not fire. Liquid gold — 
viscous, slow, carrying its own internal luminosity 
as it moves down the obsidian surfaces, 
pooling at invisible bases below frame. 
Each column becomes its own light source: 
the gold's self-emitted amber glow 
radiates outward through the surrounding darkness 
in a radius determined purely by the flow rate — 
faster where the column is tall, 
slower where the gold has begun to cool 
and thicken near the base. 
The closest columns to the woman glow warmest. 
The columns at the frame's periphery 
are barely distinguishable from the void — 
only the faint amber line of their gold 
tracing down the obsidian confirms 
they exist at all.

No candles. No flame. No combustion. 
The ritual does not require fire 
when the material itself is already giving light.

The space between the woman and the nearest columns: 
suspended gold particulate — not flakes, not droplets, 
but a fine suspension of metallic dust 
caught in whatever atmosphere this void holds. 
It catches the column-light at oblique angles 
and creates a soft interference field 
between her body and the background columns — 
a semi-transparent golden haze 
that softens the obsidian geometry 
without diffusing it into abstraction.

COLOR PALETTE 60/30/10:
60% — absolute void black (#08080C / #0A0A0E) 
as the dominant space — not a background, 
a substance. The darkness here has mass.
30% — deep crimson lacquer and obsidian-reflected 
amber (#6B1A1A / #8B2020 / #3D1008) — 
the woman's suit, the column surfaces catching 
the gold flow's warmth, the darkest pooling zones 
where liquid gold cools to garnet.
10% — molten gold and amber emission 
(#C8922A / #E8C96A at the flow origin) — 
the cascade itself, the particle haze, 
the corona of each column's self-generated 
light field.

LIGHTING:
No external source. No rim light. No key light. 
Every photon in this frame originates from 
the flowing gold on the obsidian columns. 
The woman is lit entirely by proximity — 
warmer on her left side where the nearest 
column flows heaviest, cooler on her right 
where the void reasserts itself between 
her body and the next column. 
Her face catches the amber at a low, 
raking angle: cheekbone, brow ridge, 
the curve of her upper lip — 
everything else held in the kind of shadow 
that does not obscure but deepens.

No fill. No bounce. The void does not reflect. 
Contrast is absolute except where the gold 
suspension softens the transition 
between lit and unlit zones of her body.

Vision3 tungsten grain throughout — 
medium-coarse in the deep void zones, 
suppressed at gold-flow highlights, 
visible as fine structure on the lacquer 
bodysuit surface where the amber light 
grazes at the lowest angle.

Mood: a ceremony that was already complete 
before she arrived — she is not performing 
the ritual, she is the ritual's 
final material form, standing still 
inside a world that has been building 
toward her specific geometry 
since the gold first began to flow.

items.rawPrompt:
STYLE_PROFILE: --profile spc2tb2

INPUT A (model image): [attach]
INPUT B (clothing image): [attach]

SCENE_DIRECTION:
Fashion portrait, intense editorial mood. Close-up de cima dos ombros. Ângulo ligeiramente baixo (low angle) para evocar voyeurismo e dominância. Dutch Tilt agressivo aplicado (-30º rotação no eixo Z). Model action: sem jaqueta, t-shirt com alta tensão de tecido (cloth tension) revelando anatomia (seios marcando no tecido), mãos tensionadas segurando o cordão. Nature light, high-contrast, body in dramatic shadow.

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):
From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep), skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions, hair color and texture, facial structure.

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid, structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals, cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND (internal, do not output):
FIXED: cool crisp off-white studio backdrop — a flat, seamless, luminous surface. Not warm. Not ivory. Not grey. A near-white with a precise, subtle cool-blue shift.

EXACT COLOR VALUE — DO NOT DEVIATE:
BACKGROUND: HEX: #EEF5FC | RGB: rgb(238, 245, 252) | HSL: hsl(210°, 70%, 96%)

HUE IS LOCKED AT 210°. No deviation toward green (H<195°), no deviation toward violet (H>225°). No warm shift. No yellow. No grey-white. No pure #fff.
SATURATION: strictly between 60–75%.
LIGHTNESS: strictly between 94–97%.
Background must read as near-white with a breath of cool blue — not as a colored wall, not as a sky, not as a color-graded image.

COLOR TEMPERATURE: 6500–7000K. Crisp daylight, slightly overcast. No warm gels. No amber shift. The light must not contaminate the background tone — background and light temperature must align.

SURFACE: seamless infinity curve. If the pose is on the floor, floor and wall are the same unbroken tone. No visible seam, no horizon line, no texture on backdrop.

PROHIBITED interpretations:
— Pure white (#fff)
— Warm white or ivory
— Grey or neutral white
— Blue sky or blue wall
— Any tone that reads as "tinted" or "color-graded"
— Gradient or vignette on the background
— Textured or painted wall appearance

The background must feel: photographic studio air — the color exists as atmosphere, not as set design.

STEP 3 — EXECUTION PHILOSOPHY (internal, do not output):
CORE INSTRUCTION: Follow SCENE_DIRECTION strictly. If pose is unspecified, prioritize visual obstruction or conscious discomfort over symmetry. The model owns the frame.

TRANSLATE ABSTRACTIONS TO PHYSICS:
— Tension: Render visible muscle contraction, clenched jaw, white knuckles gripping fabric.
— Voyeurism: Utilize shallow depth of field, foreground slightly out of focus to imply physical obstruction between camera and subject.
— Attitude: Direct, challenging gaze into the lens, or completely aversive face, ignoring the camera.

items.rawPrompt: Intimate close-up low-angle snapshot taken entirely just beneath the water surface, angled sharply upward toward an East Asian young woman wading at a nighttime beach club pool. The lens is placed inches below the surface, capturing the visceral tactile intersection where air meets water. Use sophisticated "Chiaroscuro" lighting to create a dramatic contrast between the subject and the dark void. POSITIVE PROMPT
Constraints:

3:4 vertical, ultra-realistic portrait photo, high-angle close-up of a young woman in a minimal indoor setting.

Composition:

Framed from the chest to just above the cap; high-angle shot looking slightly down at the subject; subject is tilting her head up, gazing directly into the lens; wearing classic wired earphones with the cables draping down her chest; plain, seamless off-white background completely filling the rear frame.

Environment:

Indoors against a neutral backdrop; daytime studio setup; illuminated by a large, highly diffused softbox or window light positioned slightly above and in front of the subject, creating a soft, even wrap.

Materials & textures:

Heavy cotton canvas texture on the off-white baseball cap with raised, thick dark-green embroidery ("SF"); fuzzy, soft knitted texture on the green and beige plaid cardigan; distinct vertical lines on the ribbed white cotton tank top; smooth, realistic plastic and metallic finish on the wired earphone cables; clear separation between the clothing layers.

Primary focus (Subject and Facial Realism):

Natural, unretouched skin texture with visible micro-pores, fine facial hair, and a subtle natural blush on the cheeks.

Intricate iris details with clear, distinct catchlights reflecting the large soft light source.

Soft, natural shadow gradient cast by the cap's brim falling across the upper forehead and gently framing the eyes.

Individual, loose strands of wavy dark brown hair resting realistically against the face and shoulders.

Color & light:

Neutral white balance; slight warm undertones; low-to-medium contrast with a soft roll-off in the highlights and lifted, airy shadows; true-to-life colors; highly accurate skin tones with no washed-out grading or pastel filters.

Camera behavior:

50mm to 85mm portrait lens equivalent; shallow depth of field; pin-sharp focus firmly locked on the eyes and lips; natural, gradual focus falloff softening the shoulders, cardigan, and background; very subtle optical film grain; absolutely no digital over-sharpening or edge enhancement.

Overall aesthetic:

Editorial casual fashion, intimate, nostalgic 90s/Y2K effortless aesthetic; feels like a candid, high-quality editorial moment, not a heavily retouched commercial ad.

STRICT NEGATIVES
plastic skin, airbrushed, 3D render, digital painting, exaggerated depth of field, over-sharpened, heavy makeup, AI glow, bloom, fake HDR, studio commercial gloss, muddy edges, fused clothing layers, garbled embroidery, watermarks

items.rawPrompt:
Shot at eye level, slight upward tilt of 8°, 
cinematic portrait aesthetic, 
Pentax 67 with SMC 105mm f/2.4 lens, 
Kodak Ektar 100 rated at box speed — 
the material generates its own saturation.

A young woman stands at the center of a void 
that has no floor, no ceiling, no horizon — 
only the impression of depth made possible 
by what occupies it. Her arms rise in a 
geometric frame above her head, hands open 
in loose claws that arrest the air. 
Her lips part slightly — not speaking. 
Finishing something. Her gaze is directed 
into the lens with the quality of recognition: 
she knows the camera is there and has decided, 
already, what she will allow it to see.

Her bodysuit is deep crimson urushi lacquer 
rendered as fabric — single-piece, ultra-fit, 
its surface carrying the same vein pattern 
as the wave material: rivers of gold running 
through crimson-black in organic branching lines, 
fine as craquelure, luminous where they catch 
the ambient flame-light. The suit does not 
reflect light cleanly. It absorbs and re-emits, 
like the wave's interior logic applied 
to a second skin. Her wet-dark hair is slicked 
to her forehead and neck in fine artisanal 
strands — and embedded in those strands, 
near-invisible, are suspended gold-leaf fragments: 
the same dispersed material from the broken 
wave crest, now carried in hair rather than air.

Around her: dozens of columns rising from the void, 
their bodies cast in transparent acrylic but 
internally suffused with crimson lacquer pigment — 
each column a vertical cross-section of the wave, 
compressed into a cylinder, held still. 
Atop each column, white candles burn — 
hundreds of flames, each independent, 
each creating a point of amber light in the black. 
The wax does not drip as wax. 
It moves down the column faces as slow gold lacquer, 
viscous, following the same logic as the wave's 
gold veins — the same material at a different 
temperature, a different rate of descent. 
Where wax-lacquer pools at the column bases, 
it catches the surrounding flame-light and 
becomes briefly mirror-glossy before going cold.

Between the lens and the subject: 
a near plane of crystallized wax droplets 
suspended mid-fall — each one a convex 
mercury-gold sphere, refracting the candle-field 
behind them, each containing an inverted 
compressed image of the entire void. 
They are frozen at 1/125s — slow enough 
that the flame-light registers as warm smear 
on their curved surfaces. The woman is perceived 
through this foreground interference. 
She does not acknowledge it. It belongs to 
the space, not to her.

Rim light: a single cool source — 
deep slate-teal, barely perceptible — 
traces the outermost edge of her silhouette 
against the black: left arm, left shoulder, 
the outer curve of raised hand. 
This is the only cool note in the frame. 
It is sufficient. It separates her from the void 
without removing her from it.

COLOR PALETTE 60/30/10:
60% — deep crimson-lacquer black 
(#3A0A0A / #4A0F0F) 
as the void, the column bodies, 
the shadow valleys of the suit, 
the pooled wax at column bases. 
Absolute in the deepest zones, 
no lifted blacks — only Ektar's 
color density softening the floor 
of the shadow rather than lifting it.
30% — gold-amber flame and vein 
(#C8922A / #E8B84B / #A67820) — 
the candle-field as ambient source, 
the lacquer vein pattern on the suit, 
the crystallized mercury foreground spheres, 
the slow wax descent down column faces.
10% — deep slate-teal 
(#1E3A40 / #0D2B6B) — 
the rim light on her silhouette, 
barely legible inside the transparent 
acrylic column cores, the one 
chromatic resistance against the warm 
dominance of everything else.

LIGHTING:
Primary: the candle-field — 
hundreds of point sources, 
no single origin, ambient warmth 
accumulating from all directions 
without creating directional shadow. 
The figure is lit from everywhere 
the flames exist and from nowhere 
specifically. High contrast — 
the warmth is absolute where 
it reaches her, absolute darkness 
where it does not.
Secondary: the lacquer surfaces 
on suit and columns emit their 
own secondary warmth through 
internal reflection — the same 
emissive material logic as the wave, 
now vertical, ritualized, stationary.
Tertiary: single cool rim trace — 
not fill, not correction. 
Just the edge that proves 
she is not made of the same 
material as the void behind her. 
Not yet.

Ektar grain throughout — 
present in the void's deep blacks 
and the column shadow faces, 
suppressed at gold-flame highlights, 
visible on skin where warm light 
contacts pore texture at the 
décolletage and forearms.

Mood: the ceremony is already over. 
What we are witnessing is the last 
position of the last gesture — 
the arms still raised, the lips still 
parted, the wax still moving. 
The lacquer remembers the wave. 
The flames remember the sun 
that was never there. 
The woman remembers something 
we are not permitted to know.
